name: kernel-workbench
description: Configure, build, run and debug the Linux kernel in QEMU, and prepare, check, send and apply patch series, with blame, file history, bisect and KUnit.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --strict --target es2022 --module commonjs --types node,vscode extension.js src/*.js
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration

kernelDev.arch.description: Default architecture for trees where none was picked in the Kernel panel. Empty: the host architecture.

kernelDev.variant.description: Default build variant for trees where none was picked in the Kernel panel.

kernelDev.configure.defconfig.markdownDescription: Default base config: one or more make targets (`defconfig`, `defconfig kvm_guest.config`, `tinyconfig`) or a path to a `.config` file. The status bar picker overrides it per arch.

kernelDev.configure.fragments.markdownDescription: Config fragments merged after the base config (`scripts/kconfig/merge_config.sh`). Paths relative to the kernel tree, e.g. `kernel/configs/debug.config`.

kernelDev.configure.options.markdownDescription: Kconfig options applied last, without the `CONFIG_` prefix: `"y"`, `"n"`, `"m"`, a number or a string. Example: `{ "KASAN": "y", "LOG_BUF_SHIFT": "18" }`.

kernelDev.configure.qemuOptions.markdownDescription: Kconfig options applied when `kernelDev.run.mode` is `qemu`, so the kernel can boot from an initramfs given in `kernelDev.run.initramfs`.

kernelDev.configure.virtmeOptions.markdownDescription: Kconfig options needed by virtme-ng (applied when `kernelDev.run.mode` is `virtme`).

kernelDev.toolchain.markdownDescription: `gcc`: `CROSS_COMPILE=<prefix>` when cross compiling. `llvm`: `LLVM=1` for every arch. Takes effect at the next Configure.

kernelDev.crossCompile.markdownDescription: `CROSS_COMPILE` prefix per arch for gcc builds. Defaults: `aarch64-linux-gnu-`, `riscv64-linux-gnu-`, `x86_64-linux-gnu-` (none for the host arch).

kernelDev.make.ccache.markdownDescription: Compile through ccache: Configure records `CC="ccache gcc"` (with the cross prefix) or `CC="ccache clang"`. Rebuilds after switching branches or Debug/Release get much faster. Takes effect at the next Configure.

kernelDev.make.args.markdownDescription: Extra make arguments, recorded at Configure and used by every Build, e.g. `["W=1"]`, `["CC=ccache gcc"]`, `["KCFLAGS=-Og"]`.

kernelDev.buildDirectory.markdownDescription: Build output (`O=`), relative to the kernel tree or absolute. `${arch}` and `${variant}` are substituted.

kernelDev.clangd.updateCompileCommands.markdownDescription: After each build, write the build's `compile_commands.json` to the root of the tree for clangd (gcc-only flags stripped) and restart clangd.

enumDescriptions: Keep the terminal open until you press a key
Close the terminal as soon as the step finishes (errors stay in the Problems panel)
kernelDev.terminal.afterTask.description: What happens to the terminal of Configure / Build / Clean / Full clean when it finishes.

markdownEnumDescriptions: QEMU, with the initramfs from `kernelDev.run.initramfs` if one is set
virtme-ng (`vng`), booting the host root filesystem
kernelDev.run.mode.description: How Run and Debug boot the kernel.

kernelDev.run.initramfs.markdownDescription: Initramfs to boot with, per arch, e.g. `{ "arm64": "/srv/initramfs/arm64.cpio.gz" }`. If none is set for the arch, the kernel boots without an initramfs (give `root=` in `kernelDev.run.cmdline` and a disk in `kernelDev.run.qemuArgs`).

kernelDev.run.kvm.description: auto: use KVM when the arch is native and /dev/kvm is accessible.

kernelDev.buildBeforeRun.description: Run an incremental build before Run and Debug.

kernelDev.run.shareBuildDir.markdownDescription: Share the build directory with the QEMU guest over 9p (read-only), so freshly built modules can be loaded with `insmod` without rebuilding the initramfs. Configure then enables the 9p and virtio options; Run shows the `mount` command for the guest.

kernelDev.debug.gdb.description: gdb binary. Empty: gdb for the host arch, gdb-multiarch otherwise.

kernelDev.debug.breakAt.description: Run to this symbol (hardware breakpoint) before the debugger attaches, so normal breakpoints work. Empty: attach at reset.

kernelDev.debug.stopOnEntry.description: Stay paused at breakAt when the debugger attaches, instead of running to your breakpoints.

kernelDev.debug.gdbCommands.description: Extra gdb commands run when the debugger starts.

kernelDev.debug.stopVmWhenDebuggingEnds.description: Kill QEMU when the debug session ends.

kernelDev.blame.ignoreWhitespace.markdownDescription: Blame with `-w`: whitespace-only changes don't count as changing a line.

kernelDev.blame.detectMoves.markdownDescription: Blame with `-M -C`: follow lines moved within the file or copied from other files changed in the same commit. Slower (about 6s instead of 2.4s on kernel/sched/core.c).

kernelDev.patches.base.markdownDescription: Base of a patch series when the branch has no upstream and none was picked in the Series view: the series is the commits since its merge-base with this ref.

kernelDev.checkpatch.strict.markdownDescription: Run checkpatch with `--strict` (some subsystems, e.g. networking, expect it).

kernelDev.check.sparse.markdownDescription: Also run sparse (`C=2`) on the touched files in Check series. Needs a sparse recent enough for the kernel.

kernelDev.check.coccinelle.markdownDescription: Also run `make coccicheck MODE=report` on the touched directories in Check series. Needs `coccinelle` and `ocaml-nox`.

kernelDev.patches.outputDirectory.markdownDescription: Where Generate patches writes the series, relative to the kernel tree or absolute. `${branch}` and `${version}` are substituted.

kernelDev.apply.addLink.markdownDescription: When fetching a series with `b4 am`, add a `Link:` trailer to each patch (`-l`).

kernelDev.apply.addSignoff.markdownDescription: When fetching a series with `b4 am`, add your `Signed-off-by:` to each patch (`-s`).

kernelDev.kunit.buildDirectory.markdownDescription: Build directory for `kunit.py` (kept apart from your normal builds), relative to the kernel tree or absolute. `${arch}` is substituted.

kernelDev.kunit.kunitconfig.markdownDescription: `.kunitconfig` (file or directory) for the Testing view's runs, e.g. `lib/kunit` or `kernel/sched`. Empty: kunit.py's default set.
